sources.excerpt: Broughton Audio Introduces the Fliptop Preamp Pedal – No Treble Skip to main content No Treble Gear Basses Amps Pedals & Effects Accessories & Strings Pickups Bass of the Week Gear Reviews News New Albums Sheet Music & Instruction Concerts & Tours Events Columns From the Bottom Bass Players To Know Ask Damian Erskine Recording Bass The Lightbulb Moment The Lowdown with Dr. D Health & Fitness Lessons Keep It Groovy Bass Gym Talking Technique Bass Transcriptions The Brown’stone Creative Bass Lines Bass & Creativity Bass Lick Series Advanced Bass Talking Style Bassists Interviews Wonder Women Stories Behind the Songs Reader Spotlight In Memoriam Share Your Story Videos Podcast Bass Nerds Podcast Groove Podcast Shop Subscribe Archives On This Day in Bass Contributors Contact Home Bass Gear Pedals & Effects Broughton Audio Introduces the Fliptop Preamp Pedal by Kevin Johnson Friday, May 17th, 2024 Share Tweet Email Comments Broughton Audio has introduced the Fliptop, a pedal that combines the magic of the B15 amplifier with a more portable unit. The JFET preamp is modeled after the iconic amp, with gain staging and EQ sections that give the feel and response of a vintage tube amp. “In addition to the James stack EQ and gain staging, the Fliptop adds a Master volume control on the output so you can dial in the amount of drive you want while adjusting the volume as needed,” they add. Additionally, a Cab knob acts as a wet/dry control to apply cab tone to the preamplifier’s output. “Dialing in more of the cab response tightens the low end and cuts the high frequencies for a warm, vintage tone. The frequency response is modeled after the 15″ cab,” Broughton explains. The Broughton Audio Fliptop is available now direct for $185. Broughton Audio Fliptop Preamp Pedal Features: Modeled after B-15 2-band James Stack EQ Gain and Master Knobs Cab Knob True Bypass 9-24V DC power Dimensions: 4.77″ long x 2.6″ wide In his time with No Treble, Kevin has met hundreds of amazing bassists and interviewed icons like Jack Casady, Victor Wooten, Les Claypool, Marcus Miller, and more. He's a gigging bassist performing jazz in Northern Virginia and bluegrass with The Plate Scrapers up and down the East Coast. Kevin appreciates all genres of music, from R&B to metal and everything in between. Connect with Kevin on Facebook and check his performance schedule on his website . sources.excerpt: FlipTop by Broughton Audio | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Broughton Audio FlipTop LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS PREAMP EQUALIZER BOOSTER CAB SIM Description The Fliptop is a JFET preamplifier that is modeled after the B15 amplifier. The gain staging and EQ sections were carefully designed to give the feel and response of the vintage tube amp, offering a good range of pillowy tone that can be driven to the point of light overdrive if pushed. In addition to the James stack EQ and gain staging, the Fliptop adds a Master volume control on the output so you can dial in the amount of drive you want while adjusting the volume as needed. The Cab knob is essentially a wet/dry control, allowing you to apply 0 to 100% of the cab tone to the preamplifier output. Dialing in more of the cab response tightens the low end and cuts the high frequencies for a warm, vintage tone. The frequency response is modelled after the 15" cab.
